text:
rachel: Quick signal from the canary: preview invoice totals jumped for a handful of tenants after the routing reshard. Looks like the same session was attributed twice under two route_ids.

tom: can you paste the minimal repro?

rachel: heres two consecutive events from the edge (sanitized):

{
  "session_id": "s-9z",
  "route_id": "r-1",
  "tokens": 220,
  "ts": 1716009955
}
{
  "session_id": "s-9z",
  "route_id": "r-4",
  "tokens": 220,
  "ts": 1716009962
}

priya: ledger key is (session_id, route_id) so that explains the double-count. two immediate approaches: (A) short-term: preview-only collapse by session_id within 60s to mute noise; (B) longer-term: emit lightweight attach metadata to let tallyer stitch reassignments.

leo: attach metadata sounds better long-term. idea: edge emits an attach event when a session moves with a small attach_token + prev_route. ingest writes last_attach for session into a small TTL kv and tallyer uses it to merge overlapping batches.

tom: what about a monotonic seq per session instead? safer but needs durable counters on edge. more ops work.

rachel: preference: ship preview collapse today (feature-flag) so alerts stop, then implement attach_token flow next sprint. we also need a console affordance that shows reassignments so customers/SREs can see per-route shifts.

priya: agree. metrics to add: dedupe_rate_preview, attach_hit_rate, fallback_collapses. plus a small debug endpoint listing recent attach events for a tenant.

leo: security note: attach_token must not be exported to billing exports; mark as internal-only. small random token fine.

billing-bot: preview-alert: billing-delta spike 1716009920-1716010000 for tenants t-sky, t-omega.

tom: action items:
- tom/priya: preview collapse transform (feature-flag) + metric emits (today)
- leo: design attach_event schema and ingest kv TTL pattern (spike)
- rachel: mock console reassignments card and add tooltip describing dedupe rules

rachel: also please add a CI test that simulates a route flip so we don't regress.

priya: will add tests and a small dashboard showing how many events were deduped per tenant.

rachel: thanks everyone. landing preview mute first then follow up with the attach_token rollout.
